description: Public series are rewritten by scripts/refresh-data.mjs. manual series are not on an automatic feed and are not backfilled.

storage.reasonDirect: agsi.gie.eu returns access denied without an x-key. This block is the Voltstack public CSV, whose source column attributes GIE AGSI+. The script does not call AGSI and does not invent earlier gas days.
storage.source: GIE AGSI+ via Voltstack EU Gas Storage Map

hdd.note: Northwest Europe temperature and HDD proxy from Open-Meteo historical weather. Base 18°C. Not an ECMWF operational forecast.

ttf.reason: ICE Dutch TTF is not reachable without a paid key. This figure is the desk snapshot kept on the calculator. It is not an ICE settlement, and this script does not add points after the snapshot date.

spark25.reason: Spark Commodities is not reachable without a paid key. points are the desk path from before the public refresh (SPARK_SHAPE scaled to the 2026-09-29 snapshot of 25500 $/day), spaced one week apart and ending on that snapshot. They are not Spark assessments. This script must not replace them with a live feed or collapse them to the single snapshot.

blng2.reason: Baltic Exchange BLNG2 is not reachable without a paid key. No dated print is stored, so the chart has no BLNG2 points.

lgo.reason: ICE low-sulphur gasoil is not reachable without a paid key. This figure is the desk snapshot. It is not an ICE settlement, and this script does not add points after the snapshot date.
